offers_products.reason: Builds and sells single-family homes, townhomes, condos under Century Communities and Century Complete brands.

offers_services.reason: Homebuilding is the main business; mortgage, title and insurance affiliates are ancillary to home sales.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Homes are sold to individual homebuyers, including online purchases and mortgage financing for them.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Buyers are households purchasing homes; no significant business or government buyers indicated.

recurring_revenue.reason: Homes are one-time purchases; buyers don't repeatedly buy from the builder.

cyclical_demand.reason: New home purchases are easily postponed in downturns and sensitive to rates and economy.

big_ticket.reason: A home is the largest, most infrequent purchase for a household.

people_delivered.reason: Revenue comes from selling built homes, not from staff time and skill.

large_customers.reason: Customers are households buying homes, not large enterprises or government.

asset_heavy.reason: Homebuilder investing in land and inventory, but no plants or fleets; construction uses subcontractors.

notes: Land and inventory investment is significant, so asset_heavy is a judgment call.
